name: Business Directory Seed Schema
purpose: Canonical shape for scraped/imported businesses that should materialize into generated/platform-data/business-directory.json.

fields.name: Business or organization display name.
fields.address: Street or mailing address if public.
fields.city: City/market, e.g. Glendale, Phoenix, Mesa, Scottsdale, Tempe.
fields.state: State code, defaults to AZ when omitted during materialization.
fields.sourceUrl: Public source URL used for verification/provenance.
fields.verified: Boolean or evidence flag showing this was reviewed or source-backed.
